questions.explanation: Greenstick fractures occur in children.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.subject: General Surgery & Orthopedics

questions.question: Normal hip medial rotation range is approximately:
questions.explanation: Lateral rotation about 45°.
questions.sourceBook: Neumann, Kinesiology of the Musculoskeletal System; Kisner & Colby, Therapeutic Exercise; Daniels & Worthingham; Norkin & Levangie, Joint Structure and Function (chapter-level reference)
questions.subject: Kinesio Therapeutics

questions.question: Following are the branches of posterior cord of branchial plexus except:
questions.explanation: The dorsal scapular nerve arises directly from the C5 root; the posterior cord gives the axillary, radial and subscapular/thoracodorsal nerves.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.subject: Anatomy

questions.question: A therapist designs a research study which examines the effect of functional knee bracing on speed and agility. In this study speed and agility are the:
questions.explanation: The outcome measured (speed and agility) is the dependent variable; bracing is the independent variable.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.sourceChapter: Cited reference: Research Methods for Clinical Therapist/ Hicks/4th Ed./Pg. 70
questions.subject: Physiotherapy in Community Health

questions.question: A therapist examines an electrocardiogram of a patient during exercise. What change in the electrocardiogram would be indicative of myocardial ischemia?
questions.explanation: ST-segment depression is the classic ECG sign of myocardial ischaemia during exercise.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.subject: Physiotherapy in General Medical & Surgical Condition

questions.question: A therapist develops a physical therapy problem list after competing an initial examination on a patient diagnosed with right shoulder impingement. Which of the following entries would not typically belong in the physical therapy problem list?

options.A: Decreased active right shoulder lateral rotation
options.B: Decreased strength of the right upper trapezius and middle deltoid
options.C: Increased pain with right shoulder active movement
options.D: Increased stress secondary to financial problems

questions.explanation: Financial stress is not a physical therapy problem-list item for shoulder impingement.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.subject: Physiotherapy in Musculoskeletal Condition

questions.question: Replacement of calcified articular cartilage by bone occurs by:
questions.explanation: Calcified cartilage is replaced by bone through endochondral ossification.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.subject: Anatomy

questions.question: A therapist volunteers to assist participants at the finish line in a 10K rod race. The race takes place on a hot and humid day and some of the race organizers are concerned about the potential for heat related disorders such as heat exhaustion and heat stroke. The most significant variables to different between heat exhaustion and heat stroke are:
questions.explanation: Mental status and skin temperature distinguish heat exhaustion from heat stroke.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.subject: Physiotherapy in General Medical & Surgical Condition

questions.question: The earth pin should be connected to:

options.A: The wire with black or blue color
options.B: The wire with yellow or green color
options.C: The wire with red or brown color

questions.explanation: The earth wire is yellow/green.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.subject: Fundamentals of Electro Therapy

questions.question: A physical therapist conducts an initial examination on a patient diagnosed with Parkinson's disease. Which of the following clinical findings would you expect the therapist to identify?
questions.explanation: Cogwheel rigidity is characteristic of Parkinson's disease.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.subject: Physiotherapy in Neurosciences

questions.question: A therapist examines a patient recently admitted to the hospital with uncontrolled diabetes mellitus. The physical therapy referral is for daily whirlpool treatments for a decubitus ulcer. Which of the following signs and symptoms might the therapist expect based on the supplied information?
questions.explanation: Uncontrolled diabetes causes hyperglycaemia with polydipsia, polyuria and polyphagia.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.subject: Physiotherapy in General Medical & Surgical Condition

questions.question: The storage form of glucose in animals is:
questions.explanation: Stored mainly in the liver and muscle.
questions.sourceBook: U. Satyanarayana, Biochemistry; Harper's Illustrated Biochemistry (chapter-level reference)
questions.subject: Biochemistry

questions.question: The commonest cause of bacterial meningitis in adults is:
questions.explanation: Neisseria meningitidis in young adults.
questions.sourceBook: Davidson's Principles and Practice of Medicine; Harrison's Principles of Internal Medicine (chapter-level reference)
questions.subject: Medicine

questions.question: The most common site at disc prolapse is:
questions.explanation: L4-L5 is the commonest level of lumbar disc herniation (with L5-S1).
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.subject: Physiotherapy in Musculoskeletal Condition

questions.question: A physiotherapist instructs a patient to move her lower teeth forward in relaxation to the upper teeth. This motion is termed as:
questions.explanation: Forward movement of the mandible is protrusion.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.subject: Physical Diagnosis & Manipulative Skills

questions.question: Which one of the following is true regarding production of ultrasound?

options.A: Ultrasound is produced by electromagnetic induction
options.B: Ultrasound is produced by piezo- electric effect
options.C: Ultrasound is produced by reverse piezoelectric effect

questions.explanation: Ultrasound is produced by the reverse piezoelectric effect.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.sourceChapter: Cited reference: Physical Agent in Rehabilitation/Cameron/2nd Ed./Pg. 193
questions.subject: Fundamentals of Electro Therapy

questions.question: A physical therapist examines a five-year-old child's gait. The therapist notes that the child is unsteady and uses a wide base of support. The child appears to lurch at times with minimal truncal bobbing in an anterior and posterior direction. The child cannot maintain a standing position with the feet placed together for more than five seconds. The area of the brain most likely affected is the:
questions.explanation: A wide-based, unsteady, lurching gait with truncal sway and a positive Romberg-type instability indicates cerebellar dysfunction.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.sourceChapter:
Cited reference: Neurology and Neurosurgery Illustrated/

Lindsay/4th Ed./Pg. 189/

questions.question: To stretch adherent scar, the ion selected for iontophoresis is:
questions.explanation: Chloride delivered at the cathode is used to soften adherent scar.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.subject: Fundamentals of Electro Therapy

questions.question: A therapist completes a developmental assessment on a three month old child. Which reflex is simulated by the head suddenly dropping into extension?
questions.explanation: Sudden head drop into extension elicits the Moro reflex.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.subject: Physiotherapy in Neurosciences

questions.question: A therapist employed in a community health practice presents an inservice to group of expectant mothers. As part of the inservice the therapist facilitates a discussion on cesarean sections. Which of the following would not be an indication for a cesarean section?

options.D: Full effacement and dilation of the cervix

questions.explanation: Full effacement and dilatation of the cervix is normal progress of labour, not an indication for caesarean section.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.subject: OBGY

questions.question: Surfactant, produced by type II pneumocytes, acts by:

options.B: Reducing alveolar surface tension and preventing collapse

questions.explanation: Deficiency causes neonatal respiratory distress syndrome (hyaline membrane disease).
questions.sourceBook: A.K. Jain, Textbook of Physiology; Guyton & Hall, Textbook of Medical Physiology (chapter-level reference)
